description: This file defines the LocationCurrentRequest enum with utility methods for requesting and resolving current location data using CoreLocation. It includes a timeout mechanism, location caching based on timestamp, and mapping accuracy levels to CoreLocation constants.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Requests current location data, returns cached location if recent enough, otherwise performs location request with optional timeout.

methods.name: accuracyValue
methods.description: Maps OpenClawLocationAccuracy enum to CLLocationAccuracy constant.
